title: mut.feedback
mutation_directive: Kusama-obsessive Lucy is a strong concept BUT the per-particle motion currently looks RANDOM / messy. Make the trajectory INTENTFUL — pick ONE coherent flow law per piece: (a) TORNADO — particles spiral around a vertical axis with radius increasing as they rise/fall, (b) RAIN — particles fall along gravity with slight horizontal drift, accumulate or pass through the figure, (c) MAGNETIC FIELD LINES — particles follow visible streamlines emanating from poles, (d) BREATHING TIDE — coordinated inhale-exhale radial expansion/contraction. NEVER independent random walks. The MOTION must read as a single intelligent system, not 60k independent dice rolls.

casey_reas.praise: The breathing tide is the right instinct — one global phase variable with per-particle offset is exactly the kind of deterministic local rule that produces coherent global behavior. The `breathCycle = uBreathPhase + phase * π` propagation reads as a genuine rule-system, not noise.
casey_reas.concern: The Kusama palette (vivid #e81a23 red on ivory) is decorative and culturally referential — it overwhelms the rule-structure. The piece is announcing a brand, not revealing an emergent process. The dot lattice is ornamental, not structural.
casey_reas.directive: Replace red/ivory with two near-whites; polkaDot() mask drives opacity only — no hue shift. Pure tonal emergence.

tomas_saraceno.praise: The three concentric rings at radii 22/42/64 suggest web topology — a spider's orb-weaver geometry scaled to cosmic proportion. Diminishing copy-scale (1.0 → 0.52 → 0.33 → 0.21) creates the depth-cue of vast atmospheric recession.
tomas_saraceno.concern: All ring offsets are set to `y: 0` — every copy lies on a flat horizontal disk. The figure-constellation is anchored to a gravitational ground plane, not floating in three-dimensional web-space. This collapses a potential 3D architecture into a 2D carousel.
tomas_saraceno.directive: Tilt each ring plane 20–40° on the X-axis independently so the 29 copies span 3D volume rather than a flat orbital disk.

entangled_others.praise: The per-particle `phase` offset creating wave propagation across the figure surface is the strongest biological moment here — it reads as membrane respiration, genuine peristaltic rhythm, not mechanical animation. The outer-particles-move-more scaling (`distFromCenter / 8.0`) reinforces soft tissue elasticity.
entangled_others.concern: The `polkaDot()` pattern is a human cultural citation (Kusama), not biological substrate. The form is entirely human-centered — Lucy-copies radiating outward positions the human body as the organizing logic. There's no more-than-human agency in the system.
entangled_others.directive: Replace polkaDot() lattice with Voronoi cell-boundary distance field; color by neighbor count to invoke cell-membrane biology, not art-world reference.

refik_anadol.praise: The 30-copy instanced constellation at 62k particles has genuine architectural ambition — the rings-of-Lucy read as a data-collective-memory structure, multiple instances of a body becoming a dataset. The assembly-reveal entry animation (particles gathering from dispersed cloud) is cinematic.
refik_anadol.concern: 62k particles is well below the threshold where the material overwhelms the viewer. The red/ivory palette is portrait-intimate, not monument-scale. The breathing is 'gentle' by design — at MoMA-lobby scale, gentleness reads as timidity.
refik_anadol.directive: Push N to 200k; remap: background #0a1628, breath-peak lerps ivory→cyan #00d4ff→violet #c084fc per breath amplitude.

lia_halloran.praise: The concentric ring arrangement of Lucy-copies maps directly onto star-cluster cartography — this reads as a celestial atlas of a single body repeated at varying distances and scales, which is exactly the feminist-astronomy gesture of centering a historically-erased figure in the cosmos.
lia_halloran.concern: The #080808 background is the cliché black-void space aesthetic — the exact register she has spent a decade rejecting. The Kusama red/ivory palette has no connection to cyanotype's blue-white photographic emulsion. The piece forgets its own celestial aspiration.
lia_halloran.directive: Invert: background #f2efe8, field particles Prussian blue #003153, polka dots near-white #f0f4f8 — cyanotype positive print register.
